parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.

parameters.name: IotId
parameters.description:
The ID of the device that you want to disable. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.
> **IotId** is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this **ID** value exists, you must specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or **ID** value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
